cc:Work.dc:title: Signorini adaptive mesh
cc:Work.dc:description: All 5182 published vector mesh edges from Figure 5 (right), Bartels, Gudi and Kaltenbach, arXiv:2407.10912v1, page 23. Signorini problem on (-1,1)^2 after 15 adaptive steps, theta=1/2. The projected flux arrows and original legend are omitted to show the authentic mesh alone. No refinement geometry is invented.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #1b1b1b; stroke-width: 0.33; stroke-linejoin: miter
